contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: Hostinger's Black Friday has already started: it runs from October 19 to December 14, 2026. The campaign price applies automatically, and the code **SONAR20**, entered in the cart's coupon field, takes another 20% off it. What changes the math is the renewal, explained below.

contentSections.heading: Has Hostinger's Black Friday started?
paragraphs: It has. Hostinger's official FAQ says: “Hostinger's Black Friday sale runs from October 19 to December 14, 2026.” The global page in English gives the same date.

On November 3, the campaign page in US$ shows 85% off web hosting, 67% off VPS and 75% off Reach (email marketing). Those are the banner figures, not the discount on every plan. VPS is left out of the math in this article, as explained further down.
The numbers below are for the 2026 campaign only, read from the official page.

contentSections.heading: What you pay with the campaign and with SONAR20
postParagraphs: The discount applies on top of the campaign price. On the global site, the 48-month Startup plan went from US$ 383.52 to US$ 306.82 with SONAR20 entered in the coupon field (“Have a coupon code?”).
Where to paste the code and what happens to the discount at renewal are covered in [Hostinger SONAR20 coupon](/en/reviews/hostinger-coupon-code-referral).

contentSections.heading: Who should wait and who shouldn't
paragraphs: If you need your site online this week, don't wait. On the 48-month plans we checked, the campaign with SONAR20 is already the lowest price.

If you can wait, keep in mind that the campaign runs until mid-December, but no price is guaranteed until then. The 20% from SONAR20 comes off the campaign price: if the campaign changes, the total changes with it.

For most personal, business and WordPress sites, the FAQ itself recommends Premium. Hostinger recommends Single for people just starting out or with simple projects. For VPS, do the math in the cart: the banner shows 67% on November 3, and the math in this article does not cover that plan.

If you are already a customer, check the upgrade offers in your account: the FAQ says existing customers may get separate offers. SONAR20 also works for a new plan. Bruno, who runs this site, has been a Hostinger customer since 2024, with more than 24 months of subscription. His plans are Business hosting, VPS KVM 2, email and domains, all with automatic renewal. Em Casa com Cecília runs on Hostinger.

contentSections.heading: How to check before you pay
bullets: Open [Hostinger on this site's store page](/en/coupons/hostinger) and copy the code SONAR20.
In the cart, paste SONAR20 into the coupon field and watch the 20% discount appear on top of the campaign price.
Compare the total for the first period, not just the monthly price. The total shows the real difference.
Check the renewal price before you check out. Hostinger shows it before payment, and it is not the campaign price. The 20% from SONAR20 applies to the first period and on renewal too.
postParagraphs: Before paying, what the guarantee covers and what it leaves out is in [Is Hostinger reliable?](/en/reviews/is-hostinger-legit).

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: When does Hostinger's Black Friday start and how long does it last? It has already started and runs until mid-December; the exact dates are in the quick answer at the top. The campaign page in US$ shows 85% off web hosting, 67% off VPS and 75% off Reach.

Does Hostinger's Black Friday have a coupon? The campaign price applies automatically, and the code SONAR20, entered in the cart's coupon field, takes another 20% off it. We don't mention codes from other sites.
When does Hostinger's Black Friday end? In mid-December, according to the official FAQ; the exact date is at the start of the article.
Does the Black Friday price carry over to renewal? No. It applies to the initial period of the subscription. Renewal is charged at the plan's regular price.
Does SONAR20 work together with the Black Friday price? Yes: in our test, the 20% came off the campaign price. Since the price changes, check the total in the cart.

Does the refund guarantee apply on Black Friday? The FAQ says eligible plans have a 30-day guarantee, with terms and exclusions. What it leaves out is in [Is Hostinger reliable?](/en/reviews/is-hostinger-legit).
